svg.title: How close the two arms come, one arm at a time and together
svg.desc: Closest distance between the left and right arms over time for the same 22.4-second plan. Run one arm after the other, as multi-arm plans used to run, it takes 44.8 seconds and the arms overlap, by up to 4 mm (left first) or 8 mm (right first). Run together from one start stamp, it takes 22.4 seconds and never closes below 2 mm.
